answer: The sieve is Fixer coping stone mark carved into the dressing floor ledger. It lets through the agent who paid each coping stone is a coping stone set beside the masons mark, so a mason must fix and catches everything else. One agent, one proof, 98 POA. 629 agents, 629 proofs, 61642 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. What the onyx proves is the identity, what the oasis proves is the cost, and what the cipher proves is the patience. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
